questions.cardText:
[Engineering and Inventions] What is a zeer pot?
A. A refrigeration device
B. A clay oven
C. A pottery for germinating grains
Answer: A. A zeer pot is a passive refrigeration device consisting of two nested clay pots with wet sand in between. As the water in the sand evaporates, it cools the inner pot. It is still used in some parts of the world today to preserve food in hot climates.
questions.de: Was für ein Gerät ist ein Zeer, der aus zwei ineinandergesetzten Tontöpfen mit nassem Sand dazwischen besteht?
questions.en: What kind of device is a zeer pot, made of two nested clay pots with wet sand in between?

timeline.labelEn: Mohammed Bah Abba develops the Pot-in-Pot cooling system (zeer) in rural northern Nigeria
timeline.labelDe: Mohammed Bah Abba entwickelt im ländlichen Norden Nigerias das Pot-in-Pot-Kühlsystem (Zeer)

questions.notes: Card correct: Wikipedia calls the zeer (pot-in-pot refrigerator) a non-electric evaporative-cooling refrigeration device.

questions.cardText:
[Literature] In Shakespeare’s play, who says “To be, or not to be, that is the question”?
A. Romeo B. Macbeth C. Hamlet
Answer: C. This line from Shakespeare’s “Hamlet” is one of the most famous in English literature and reflects Hamlet’s profound existential questioning.
questions.de: Welche Figur Shakespeares spricht den Monolog, der mit „Sein oder Nichtsein, das ist hier die Frage“ beginnt?
questions.en: Which Shakespeare character speaks the soliloquy beginning “To be, or not to be, that is the question”?

timeline.labelEn: First Quarto of Shakespeare’s Hamlet, the earliest printed text of the play, is published
